name: IDS_HELP_BRO_BUFFS_BODY

^f1Bro Buffs
^f0

name: IDS_HELP_BRO_OPS_BODY
value:
^f1Bro Ops
^f0
-  Complete a Bro Op Challenge on your own to earn the first reward.

- Send invites to Bros in your Brotherhood. If 1 of your friends completes the challenge, you'll get the second reward. If two friends complete the challenge you'll get the third reward.

- Check the Requests section to see which Bro Op Challenges your friends would like you to complete.

- Bro Ops change Daily, check back for new challenges and new rewards!

name: IDS_HELP_BROHOOD_BODY
value:
^f1Brotherhood
^f0
- The brotherhood can be accessed from the Bros menu.

- The Brotherhood is automatically populated by your social network friends who also play Gun Bros.

- From the Bros menu you can select friends' bros to fight alongside you.

-Select a friend's brother, then tap the make active button to bring that brother into your game.

- Using a friend's brother in your game will earn them a small amount of experience. If your friend uses your brother in their game, you will earn a small amount of experience as well. 

- Every day, each of your friend's brothers you use in gameplay will earn you a bonus reward. This reward is earned after a gameplay session. So use all of your friend's brothers in game, every day.

-Your device must be connected to a network and logged into Game Center and/or facebook to access the Brotherhood.

name: IDS_HELP_CONTROLS_BODY
value:
^f1Controls
^f0
-	The left control stick moves your Gun Bro.

-	The right control stick fires your gun in the direction pressed.

- The red panic button next to the left control stick opens your Smartillery menu. From here you can use your Smartillery power ups.

- The blue toggle button next to the right control stick switches your guns.

- The red pause button at the top left of the screen will bring up the pause menu options.

name: IDS_HELP_EXPERIENCE_BODY
value:
^f1Experience
^f0
-	Each enemy kill earns you experience.

- Experience levels up your character, which increases your health and unlocks items in the store.

name: IDS_HELP_MASTERED_BODY
value:
^f1Weapon Upgrades
^f0
- Every weapon in the game earns XP as you use it in battle.

- Upgrades can be purchased from the store.

- Upgrading a weapon can yield increases in Damage, RPM, Speed and Critical Hit Damage.

name: IDS_HELP_MULTIPLAYER_BODY
value:
^f1Multiplayer
^f0
- Login to Game Center to access Multiplayer 

- After selecting a planet and wave, use select automatch to find a game.

- You can also invite any of your GameCenter friends to start a match.

name: IDS_HELP_PERFECT_BODY
value:
^f1Perfect Wave
^f0
- When you complete a wave without taking any damage, you will earn a perfect wave.

- Each perfect wave earns you an additional 10 percent Xplodium for that wave.

name: IDS_HELP_REFINE_BODY
value:
^f1Refinement
^f0
-	The refinery processes all of the Xplodium ore you've earned in battle, and pays you coin for it.

- You must refine all of your Xplodium after each battle.

-	Tap a refinement chamber to deposit all of your Xplodium into that chamber.

- Once the appropriate time has passed, tap the chamber again to collect your coin

- The instant chamber will yield 100 percent of the Xplodium you deposit.

- Additional permanent refinement chambers can be purchased to drastically increase your yield/payout, while taking more time to refine.

-	Your device must be connected to a network and logged into Game Center and/or facebook to access all but the instant refinement chamber.

name: IDS_HELP_STORE_BODY
value:
^f1Store
^f0
- The store contains guns, armor, Smartillery power ups, and the bank.

-	Guns
After purchasing a new gun, tap the equip button to equip that gun. You may have two guns equipped at a time.

-	Armor
Armors provide stat modifiers to defense, attack, and speed. After purchasing a new armor, tap the equip button to equip that armor. You can equip head, torso, and leg armors.

-	Power Ups
Smartillery power ups include health packs, shields, full screen attacks, and other powerful in-game consumables. These items can be used by pressing the red panic button during gameplay.

- Bank
From the bank, you can purchase coin and War Buck packages. Certain items in the store can only be purchased with War Bucks. While coin can be earned by refining Xplodium, War Bucks can only be obtained through the bank. The bank also has two options for converting your left over War Bucks into coin.

name: IDS_HELP_STREAK_BODY
value:
^f1Kill Streaks
^f0
- Consecutive Zombie kills without taking damage in Horde mode will multiply points earned for an enemy kill.

name: IDS_HELP_TIPSTRICKS_BODY
value:
^f1Tips and Tricks
^f0
- Keep moving around the map to avoid being surrounded by your enemies.

- Some maps may have objects in the environment that can be used to your advantage.

- Some enemies have weak points, or can only be hurt a certain way. You'll know you've found their weakness if they flash white when you attack them.

-	Use your brotherhood. Your friends' upgraded brothers may help even the odds.

- Stock up on Smartillery power ups before heading into battle.

- Earn more Xplodium by completing consecutive waves. Each consecutive wave cleared increases the amount of Xplodium you'll earn.

- Visit the store often to upgrade your guns, armor, and to purchase Smartillery power ups.

name: IDS_HELP_VOICE_CHAT_BODY
value:
^f1Voice Chat
^f0
- Voice Chat is only available with an active WiFi connection.

- Tap the Microphone icon during Multiplayer gameplay to mute Voice Chat.

name: IDS_HELP_XPLODIUM_BODY
value:
^f1Xplodium
^f0
-	Each enemy kill earns you Xplodium.

- Xplodium ore earned in battle is refined, then traded for coin at the end of each play session.

- The Xplodium multiplier at the top right of the screen details how much bonus Xplodium you are currently earning. Each consecutive wave completed increases this multiplier.
